summary: Solo hiker reported missing on Quandary Peak after failing to check in with family; found uninjured about 5:30 p.m. by headlamp light after drifting onto a 40-degree couloir on the north face; SCRG deployed a rescue team; rescuers judged him lucky to avoid an avalanche on unstable snow.
notes: Article published 2021-01-05 says 'Sunday, 1/3/20'; weekday check: 2021-01-03 was a Sunday (2020-01-03 was a Friday) and the article's media dates are 2021/01, so 2021-01-03 is the occurrence date. Retelling of a Summit Daily report.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Quandary Peak)
